refit: quarterly expanding, separate equity and gold groups
embargo: 10 full sessions after maximum eligible label maturity before first decision

context.availability: observation close available next XNYS session, exact available_date join; no future fill
unavailable: credit: no established source within bounded acquisition
rate: candidate established source monthly, rejected for daily context
context.common_overlap_rule: All six candidates use only sessions with both context features observed for entry; all phase valuation clocks remain complete through phase end. Missing context means no new entry in any candidate. Price control also final full-history sensitivity. Exact coverage written before performance.

confidence: C04 reuses C03 production forecasts. Each quarterly group model has an independent trailing 252-session chronological calibration tail, with fit labels matured 10 full sessions before calibration first decision. Median absolute out-of-sample calibration residual (q=.50), no tuning. C04 enters only prediction minus q > 0. Confidence is fraction of calibration residual magnitudes below predicted return, a diagnostic not a probability guarantee.
selection: development only across all eight risk/cost/share scenarios: count CAGR above both maximum of matching SPY cash-dividend investable and reinvested after-cost total-return and T05 CAGR and DD<=.10; worst CAGR minus max(both baseline CAGR) minus twice excess DD over.10; lower turnover; lexical ID. Lock one of P01,P02,C03,C04; trends are baseline/ablation only. Validation may reject, never replace.
sensitivity: Final P01 without common-context entry mask (all eight scenarios); finalist no trend-filter in four whole-share scenarios; one finalist half-risk-ceilings (not guaranteed half shares) four whole-share scenarios. Never select sensitivities. Final T05 all eight scenarios full entry-history; full-history T05 must also be beaten as separate final gate.
uncertainty: paired weekly moving-block bootstrap, 2/4/8 week blocks, 2000 resamples each, seed20261021; exploratory reused-history evidence
history_status: all 2019 onward history previously inspected; final descriptive only; no prospective evidence
